transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because people keep saying I’m imagining things. But I’m not.

My wife’s relative has been coming into the house, getting at me. My tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. It’s been going on for months. He’s trying to take over my place, push me out.
Have you ever heard voices when no one was there?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I hear things in the house sometimes, but not voices like that.
Have you had any recent head injury?
Not that I can think of. I haven’t hit my head or anything recently.
Before all this started, had you begun using any drugs or had a new medical illness?
No… not that I remember. I wasn’t using drugs or anything like that. And I don’t think I got some new illness. It just… started happening.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being put into your mind by someone or something outside you?
No… I wouldn’t say that. My thoughts feel like mine, I guess. I haven’t noticed anything like someone putting them there.
Have you become much less interested in being around other people than you used to be?

A bit, yeah. I mean… I still go to work and do what I have to do. But at home I keep more to myself. I don’t really want to be around him much, so I stay out of the way. It’s made things kind of tense with my wife.
Did all of this start very suddenly, over a day or two?
No… not over a day or two. It’s been going on a while. Maybe about nine months, since my wife’s relative moved in with us.
If your wife or someone else shows you clear proof that her relative did not move your tools or interfere with your plans, are you able to accept that?

No… not really. People can show me whatever they want, but I know what’s been happening in my own house. Tools don’t just move by themselves, and my plans don’t get messed up every weekend for no reason. He’s been trying to push me out.
Have you found that your emotions feel much flatter than they used to?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it that way. I guess I still feel things. Maybe I don’t show much, but that’s kind of how I am.
Have you ever felt that someone was controlling your actions?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I do what I decide to do. I haven’t felt like somebody was… making my body move or anything like that.
Have you found yourself talking much less than you used to?
Maybe a little, I don’t know. I’m not real chatty anyway. I say what needs saying.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t seen anything other people couldn’t see, not that I know of.
Have you had much less motivation to do your usual activities than you used to?
Not really. I still get things done when I have to. Maybe I’m slower some days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost motivation.
Aside from your wife's relative trying to sabotage you, have you had any other beliefs that other people say are strange or hard to believe?

No, not other things. It’s this. Everybody keeps acting like I’m making it up, but I know he came into my house to get at me. Tools don’t just move around by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. He’s been trying to push me out of my own place.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?
No… not that I know of. People understand me fine, I think. Maybe they don’t like what I’m saying, but that’s different.
Have you had any seizures?
No, I don’t think so. Nothing like that that I know of.
Have you been told by a doctor that you have a brain or nerve condition?
No. Not that I’ve been told, anyway. Nothing with my brain or nerves.
Is it possible, in your view, that your wife’s relative could have been moving your tools and interfering with your plans in ordinary ways, without using anything supernatural or impossible?

I’m not saying it’s supernatural. He could’ve just come in and done it. Tools don’t move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. I can see what he’s doing—trying to take over my place, push me out.
Has your wife’s relative ever done something to interfere with you in a way that would be impossible in real life?

Impossible? No. I mean… people keep making it sound like I’m saying magic or something. I’m not.

He can come into the house. He can move tools. He can mess up plans. That’s real enough. It’s just… it keeps happening, and I know what he’s doing. Trying to push me out.
